text:
Maya (People Ops): quick note  we updated the Handbook section on 'Data Retention & Personnel Records' to clarify retention windows for compliance training records and manager attestations. Minimal wording change but requires managers who handle headcount/benefits to confirm reading by Fri. Link: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/data-retention :bookmark_tabs:

Oliver (Legal): TL;DR: retention windows standardized (training artefacts: 3yrs, attestations: 5yrs, panel rosters: 7yrs). We added examples for EU/UK where local regs differ.

Tara (HRBP): action for managers: 1) read 20min guidance note, 2) complete 4-min acknowledgement flow (yes/no + SSO sign), 3) bulk-verify any team attestations submitted before Mar 1. Confirmation required for anyone with direct people ops responsibilities.

Ben (Engineering Manager): is the acknowledgement required for managers outside NA/EMEA (we have small APAC offices)?

Maya (People Ops): yes globally, but regional exceptions listed in the doc. If you have staff in jurisdictions with alternate rules, the flow will surface the local requirement.

Linh (Learning): rollout plan: initial email today, auto-reminder in 72h, final warning 24h before deadline. We'll host a 20-minute drop-in to answer questions (Tue 10:00 PT). Recording + transcript will be posted.

Maya (People Ops): managers can also bulk-upload verification via CSV if they prefer to mark multiple attestations at once. CSV template below. Upload path: Manager > Compliance > Bulk Verify.

Maya (People Ops): ```csv
manager_email, employee_email, employee_id, attestation_type, date, note
ben@redwood.com, sam@redwood.com, 88123, training_ack, 2026-03-12, acknowledged via manager upload
```

Ben (Engineering Manager): thanks  will run the upload after sprint planning. Quick Q: what happens if a manager misses the deadline?

Oliver (Legal): missed managerial acknowledgement triggers an automated escalation chain: 1) reminder to manager, 2) if 7 days overdue, alert to director and HRBP, 3) if 30 days overdue, blocked from initiating certain HR workflows (e.g., new hires until cleared). All automated and logged.

Tara (HRBP): for matrix teams: the system accepts either manager attestation if two managers are on record. We'll add an FAQ bullet clarifying which manager should sign when responsibilities are split.

notify-bot: :bell: Acknowledgement flow deployed to production. Deadline Fri 18:00 PT.

Linh (Learning): reminder: failed or incomplete ack for training-quality quiz (<80%) will route employees to the refresher module. Managers will get a digest of failing scores weekly if they opt-in. Opt-in link on the handbook page.

Maya (People Ops): audit note: retention logs and CSV upload receipts are preserved per policy in the compliance S3 bucket. If you need an export for internal reviews, DM me with the time window and we'll run the job.

Ben (Engineering Manager): got it. I'll take care of my team and upload the CSV on Friday.

Maya (People Ops): thanks  ping if you need a localized manager email template or help with the bulk upload.
